headline: Sumeet Industries completes ₹199.75 cr rights issue for capacity expansion
sum: Sumeet Industries Limited has completed a ₹199.75 crore rights issue to existing shareholders, targeted at funding capacity expansion and long-term growth initiatives.
detail: Sumeet Industries, a listed cookware and consumer products manufacturer, completed the rights offering on 24 July 2026 following shareholder approval. The ₹199.75 crore proceeds are earmarked for capacity expansion and strategic long-term growth. Rights issues preserve shareholder control and are subject to SEBI (Issue of Capital and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations 2018 and Companies Act pre-emptive offer rules.
